inkling._comment: Inkling 2 Mini (Thinking Machines, Apache 2.0) on the official llama.cpp Vulkan server image, for plans/inkling-timeline.md (#67). Test only: our pinned llama.cpp does not know the model (needs #32694 + #32704). Card 2 only (renderD129 = PCI 0b:00.0, so Vulkan0 inside). Same Mesa as our image (26.0.8). Settings as zaphod's ${server} macro (incl. the #27148 cache switches) and GGML_VK_DISABLE_HOST_VISIBLE_VIDMEM (CLAUDE.md: do not undo). Sampling from the model card; reasoning effort medium as coder-2.
